summary: Completed independent testing of FASE 36 - KALENDER JADWAL. Backend APIs verified (62/69 tests passed, 7 test script issues not actual bugs). Frontend UI tested via Playwright covering 10+ user stories including calendar view, conflicts detection, RBAC, settings management. Regression testing confirmed Phases 31-35 still working correctly.

Backend: Calendar has all required fields (month, days, events, conflicts, summary, calendar, projects, assignees, unscheduled, outlook, today)
Backend: PM has configure=true and shift=true permissions
Backend: GET /api/build/calendar/settings returns pattern (7 days), holidays (18 items), thresholds, note
Backend: GET /api/build/calendar/workday correctly identifies Aug 17 as holiday (not workday)
Backend: GET /api/build/calendar/workday correctly identifies Aug 18 as workday
Backend: Site engineer can view calendar but configure=false and shift=false
Backend: Sales user denied access (403) to calendar endpoints
Backend: PM can add holiday via POST /api/build/calendar/holidays
Backend: PM can delete holiday via DELETE /api/build/calendar/holidays/{day}
Backend: PM can update settings via PUT /api/build/calendar/settings
Backend: Validation rejects all days off pattern (400)
Backend: Validation rejects threshold=0 (400)
Backend: Conflicts detection works (non_workday conflicts found for Aug 17)
Backend: Kind filter works correctly
Backend: Assignee filter works correctly
Frontend: Calendar page loads with data-testid='build-calendar-page'
Frontend: Calendar grid displays 31 days for August 2026
Frontend: Calendar summary shows 5 metrics (Acara=39, Pekerjaan telat=5, Bentrok=3, Hari kerja=24, Pelaksana=4)
Frontend: Calendar legend visible
Frontend: Aug 17 cell shows holiday name 'Hari Kemerdekaan Republik Indonesia'
Frontend: Clicking Aug 17 opens day panel with 7 events and conflict explanation
Frontend: Conflict panel shows critical_stack conflict on Aug 25 (3 pekerjaan kritis, batas 2)
Frontend: Settings button opens dialog with 7 pattern rows, 18 holiday rows, thresholds, and note mentioning 'WAJIB disesuaikan dengan SKB pemerintah'
Frontend: Site engineer can view calendar but settings/shift buttons NOT visible
Frontend: Sales user sees access denied card with user-friendly message (not technical)
Regression: Monitoring Unit tab (build-monitor-panel) loads

Regression: Bulk runs panel (build-bulk-runs-panel) visible
Regression: Papan Mandor loads for site engineer with work groups
Regression: Subcon page loads for finance user
No critical console errors (only expected CDN/WebSocket warnings and 403 for sales)
